angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 503,826 km at 61.87 pc = 0.11 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 16.1641 +/- 0.0093 mas (same row, RUWE 0.91): 61.87 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.7242 +/- 0.0081 solar radii from Nielsen et al. 2020, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of HIP 65 A b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020A&A...639A..76N/abstract): 503,826 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.781 +/- 0.027 solar masses from Nielsen et al. 2020, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of HIP 65 A b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020A&A...639A..76N/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4590 +/- 49 K from Nielsen et al. 2020, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HIP 65 A b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020A&A...639A..76N/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Nielsen et al. 2020, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HIP 65 A b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020A&A...639A..76N/abstract)

spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HIP 65 A (pscomppars): spectral type K4 V, from Nielsen et al. 2020 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020A&A...639A..76N/abstract)

ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HIP 65 A (pscomppars): age 4.1 Gyr, from Nielsen et al. 2020 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020A&A...639A..76N/abstract)
